description: Header file defining functions, structures, and classes for parsing command-line flags in the Abseil library, including handling unrecognized flags and command-line argument classification.

classes.name: UnrecognizedFlag
classes.description: Represents an unrecognized command-line flag, including its source and name.

methods.name: ParseAbseilFlagsOnly
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into recognized flags, positional arguments, and unrecognized flags.

methods.name: ParseCommandLine
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments, handling flags, unrecognized flags, and usage flags, returning remaining positional arguments.
